name: Dr Alison Ward
title: Dr / General Practitioner
description: Turn the Corner's Gender Medicine page names Dr Alison Ward as experienced in transgender medicine; the clinic offers advice on and prescription of appropriate hormones with subsequent monitoring, with a 45-minute 'Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy Initial Visit' for new patients. In her own words: 'I'm a warm, compassionate GP who tailors my care to suit each person's unique needs', with extra training in women's, sexual and reproductive health and PrEP. Works primarily at Fairfield, with occasional days at Northcote.
specialties: gender medicine, gender affirming hormone therapy, sexual and reproductive health, PrEP, paediatrics
identity: "I am a proud member of the LGBTQIA+ community."

name: Dr Andrew White
title: Dr / General Practitioner
description: I enjoy all aspects of general practice and have particular interests in education, child and adolescent health, mental health, men's health and gender-affirming care. specialties: gender-affirming care, gender affirming hormone therapy, child and adolescent health, mental health, men's health, PrEP

name: Dr Chavy Arora
title: Dr / General Practitioner
description: I have particular interest in sexual and reproductive health, menopause management, skin checks and minor procedures. I am a trained provider of IUDs and Implanon, medical abortion, PrEP, and gender affirming hormonal treatment. Named on Turn the Corner's Gender Medicine page as experienced in transgender medicine. Works exclusively at the Northcote clinic.
specialties: gender affirming hormonal treatment, sexual and reproductive health, PrEP, IUD/Implanon

name: Dr Leila Byrne
title: Dr / General Practitioner
description: I am a General Practitioner with two decades of healthcare experience, committed to a Health at Every Size (HAES) philosophy. My medical experience and background also includes sexual health, contraception, LGBTQI+ health, Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy monitoring, and PrEP. Named on Turn the Corner's Gender Medicine page as experienced in transgender medicine. Works primarily at Brunswick, with occasional days at Northcote.
specialties: gender affirming hormone therapy monitoring, LGBTQI+ health, sexual health, adolescent and youth mental health, PrEP

name: Dr Tasha Patel
title: Dr / General Practitioner (B.Med, FRACGP, Dip Child Health)
description: Tasha has built a reputation for practising LGBTQIA+ health, including hormone replacement therapy for gender affirmation. Special interests include LGBTQIA+ health, including gender-affirming care initiation and hormone therapy; she only initiates hormone therapy for gender affirmation in people over 18 years old. Currently on maternity leave (from 24 September), returning in the new year.
specialties: gender-affirming care initiation and hormone therapy, LGBTQIA+ health, women's health, sexual health, PrEP, kids' health

name: Dr Nicholas Oxenburgh
title: Dr / General Practitioner (MD, FRACGP-RG)
description: Whether you want to start gender-affirming care and hormone therapy, or are looking for sexual health care, preventive health advice, or ongoing support for a chronic condition, Nicholas is committed to helping you achieve your best possible health. specialties: gender-affirming care initiation and hormone therapy, LGBTQIA+ health, sexual health, HIV s100 prescribing
